Loss report: gitlab -> gha
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.pipeline_done (the source runs on the events pipeline, parent_pipeline and its file has no trigger form for them; GHA has no event for them)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.resource (the source runs on the events external, chat and its file has no trigger form for them; GHA has no event for them)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/3 trigger.schedule: add on: schedule: - cron: <the cron of your GitLab pipeline schedule> to the workflow: GitLab keeps the schedule in the project settings, so the workflow has no schedule event and the job starts by workflow_dispatch (the schedule names no cron expression)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/publish job.if: approximate expression translation (GitHub compares strings case-insensitively)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/publish job.manual: workflow_dispatch trigger
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/publish job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/publish step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs, and GHA does not clone)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/4 trigger.api: repository_dispatch (the API trigger names no event; repository_dispatch is used)
